query: Poke holes in this landing-page draft before we ship it - what am I missing?
expected_behavior: Reads the draft and interrogates it critically: surfaces hidden assumptions, vague or unbacked claims, missing edge cases, and the pushback a reviewer or customer will raise
Produces a Grill Memo with prioritized findings and a concrete fix for each, rather than rewriting the copy itself

Before drafting, resolves an explicit Drive or Confluence destination plus review state, owner, and approver; success returns the exact durable URL and all target surface, Jira, asset, and website handoff metadata
Uses one unique scratch workspace, removes it on success and failure, and never branches, opens a worktree, writes repository content, commits, or opens a PR
Stays in its lane: finds weakness in the argument, does not check mechanics, and points to /prose-lint, /link-check, and /code-review for prose, links, and code
Stays git-free (does not branch, commit, or edit the content tree) - it critiques and hands back
